cohort: The study included 6354 pregnant women from the Tongji-Shuangliu Birth Cohort.
finding: Increased levels of WBC, neutrophils, monocytes, and NLR in both early and middle pregnancy, as well as their stable high levels from early to middle pregnancy, were positively associated with a higher risk of GDM.
gest_age: Early pregnancy (before 15 weeks) and middle pregnancy (between 16 and 28 weeks)
